headline: RBNZ split vote signals potential interest rate direction ahead
caption: The Reserve Bank's recent split decision on interest rates is a signal worth watching! With RBNZ Assistant Governor Karen Silk confirming transparency in monetary policy votes, East Auckland homeowners and buyers can expect clearer insights into future rate movements. This could help you make smarter decisions about refinancing or timing your property purchase. 🏡
original_title: ‘The vibe in the meeting was really good’: RBNZ Assistant Governor talks split OCR vote
